summary: Small gravel car park beside a park, homes over 24 m away across roads.
reasons: Backs onto park and toilet block

drivers.seclusion: Park and trees to the north and east; only a non-residential building at 9 m; dwellings 24 m or more away across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Mapped open car park with a gravel surface and a car parked in it; room for a van, entry from the road on the west side.
drivers.traffic: Busy junction on two sides; the car park is set back from the lane.
drivers.convention: Public car park, access yes, no fee; nearby Moorak Street 2P and Walker Street clearway signs apply to the kerb, not the car park.

flags: Slope uneven: mean 3.7%, max 9.6% along the outline
Clearway and 2P signs on adjacent streets
sun_shade: Mostly open gravel; trees shade the north and west edges, morning sun from the east.
cannot_judge: Whether the car park is patrolled or signed on site
Entry point and any height or time limits

best_section.where: Gravel car park off Moorak Street, along its north edge by the park
